## 3. Production Systems & Showcase Catalog

### 1. Agent Critiq (Live Benchmark & MCP Server)
- **Live URL:** https://agentcritiq.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/agent-critiq-showcase
- **Description:** Curated, AI-native benchmark platform that tests, rates, and categorizes 100+ autonomous AI agent frameworks and developer tools.
- **Key Features:**
  - Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server allowing Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other agentic LLMs to query live benchmarks.
  - Open dataset published directly to HuggingFace.
  - Distributed Cloudflare Workers and Hono backend with edge caching.

### 2. Dona Mistik (Live Ephemeris & AI Astrology)
- **Live URL:** https://mistik.donacodex.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-mistik-showcase
- **Description:** Privacy-first astrological intelligence platform calculating real-time natal charts and astronomical ephemerides.
- **Key Features:**
  - High-precision planetary position algorithms based on Swiss Ephemeris data.
  - 22 Major Arcana Jungian analytical psychology tarot engine.
  - Fully client-side computation ensuring zero telemetry leaks for personal birth data.

### 3. Dona Nova (Live 3D Geospatial Intelligence)
- **Live URL:** https://donanova.donacodex.workers.dev
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-nova-showcase
- **Description:** Planetary-scale 3D WebGL intelligence visualization depicting real-time energy, environmental, and telecommunications infrastructure.
- **Key Features:**
  - Real-time rendering of 35,000+ global power plants and live carbon telemetry.
  - Interactive 3D visualization of submarine fiber-optic cables connecting continents.
  - Low-overhead GPU particle systems running in native WebGL.

### 4. Dona Codex: Vision (Proprietary Financial LLM)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-codex-vision-showcase
- **Description:** Financial Transformer language model specifically trained on high-frequency orderbook microstructure, macro indicators, and crypto asset yields.
- **Tech Stack:** PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, CUDA 12.4, FastAPI.
- **Performance:** 14.2k requests/sec throughput, 1.2ms latency on GPU tensor cores.

### 5. ApexBrain Nexus (Actor-Critic DRL Quant Trading Agent)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-nexus-showcase
- **Description:** Quantitative trading model trained via Deep Reinforcement Learning (Actor-Critic) on Level-5 orderbook depth and Cumulative Volume Delta (CVD).
- **Performance:** Documented +74.24% ROI on backtested out-of-sample market microstructure regimes.

### 6. Dona Æon (Spiking Neural Network Digital Organism)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-aeon-showcase
- **Description:** Simulation of an embodied digital lifeform governed by Karl Friston's Free Energy Principle (FEP).
- **Architecture:** 512-neuron Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) spiking neocortex exhibiting active inference and adaptive homeostatic regulation.

### 7. Dona Codex: Overmind (Autonomous Multi-Agent Enterprise OS)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-codex-overmind-showcase
- **Description:** Hierarchical multi-agent operating system coordinating autonomous agents across finance, code generation, marketing, and systems monitoring.

### 8. Dona Quantum (CrewAI Quant Research Framework)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-quantum-showcase
- **Description:** Multi-agent quantitative analysis platform using CrewAI to orchestrate specialized market analysts, risk auditors, and strategy validators.

### 9. Dona Grid (Dynamic Spot Arbitrage Bot)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/dobby-aidev/dona-grid-showcase

### 10. AI Prompt Studio (Production Prompt Engineering Suite)

### 11. AI Coin Empire (Live Multiplayer Stategy Game)

---

## 4. Architectural Principles
1. **Zero Framework Bloat:** Systems prioritize Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Vanilla CSS3, and native WebGL for minimal bundle sizes and instant load times.
2. **Privacy-Preserving:** Client-side compute is favored to ensure sensitive telemetry and personal data never leave the user's browser without explicit authorization.
3. **Open Source & Reproducibility:** Public repositories are cleanly structured, documented, and screened against credential leakage.
